mentions.name: Agent-connected kanban board
mentions.description: A kanban board that AI agents can interact with over MCP, enabling a more reliable, repeatable development process. It supports rapidly prototyping ideas from the backlog and working through them without losing work or repeating oneself.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm making a glorified kanban board that an agent can talk to over MCP, and I've found that it's given me a much more reliable, repeatable dev process, and allows me to rapidly prototype ideas in my backlog and work through them without losing work or having to repeat myself much.
